c74object.name: evi.allpass~
c74object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP allpass~ filter delay
c74object.description:
evi.allpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_allpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.allpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Cubic interpolated allpass filter delay unit. The same structure as MSP allpass~, but with cubic interpolation for smoother high end decays, and a tamed gain coefficient so no digital clipping or aliasing. Quite different than MSP. This abstraction also includes an optional feedbackmix attribute which does ridiculous nonlinear comb effects (default off).

inlet.description: Not smoothed internally. Applies negative or positive gain to the feedforward and feedback paths.

attribute.name: feedbackmix
attribute.description: If > 0, applies saturating gain stage to the internal feedback path.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.
